old_text:
FIFA Chief of Operations Kevin Lamour leaves after criticizing Gianni Infatino
Issued on:
FIFA's Director of Operations Kevin Lamour has been dismissed from his post. He had strongly criticised Gianni Infantino and his plan to set up a commercial company.
Rodri and João Cancelo have arrived in Barcelona. Ayoub Bouaddi could replace the Spaniard at Manchester City. In tennis, Aryna Sabalenka has confirmed that she will be playing alongside Novak Djokovic. Félix Lebrun is the new world number two in table tennis.
